messages:
aya: quick design check on the API Keys page. two pain points: long scope lists make rows tall, and the post-create key UX (toast-only) causes users to lose ephemeral keys. mock: https://figma.com/file/new-mock

mike: saw it. propose compact row: left expiry pill (if ephemeral), name, compressed scope summary 'read, write, +2', then actions: Copy (ghost) + kebab. on mobile collapse actions to kebab but keep Copy visible.

sam: accessibility: compressed summary must expose an offscreen full-scope string for screen readers, e.g., aria-hidden chips + visually-hidden 'Scopes: read, write, deploy, audit'. if user opens scopes dialog make it a focus-trapped dialog.

nora: reveal flow: require a short confirmation if the user's session auth is older than 15m. aria-label for reveal should be 'Reveal API key. Visible for 30 seconds.' announce via polite live region when key is revealed.

kim: create modal copy tweak: replace 'This key will be shown once' with 'This key will be revealed only once. Save it now; you will not be able to view it again.' also add small inline hint next to scopes: 'Grant minimum required permissions.'

aya: post-create: instead of toast-only, show a one-time inline preview row with the key value and expiry pill. include a progress indicator and a 'Pin reminder' action. toast can still show but as secondary.

mike: revoke pattern: destructive modal with optional reason radio and freeform note (for auditing). show privacy hint: 'Notes visible to org admins for troubleshooting.' back-end will store reason and note in audit log.

sam: keyboard behavior: make each row a single tab stop. arrow keys navigate between rows for power users; enter focuses actions. document both tab- and arrow-based navigation in spec.

nora: copy microcopy: when key is revealed show inline text 'Visible for 30s — copy now' with a progress ring. copy button should update to 'Copied!' for 2s and announce via aria-live polite region.

kim: implementation note: front-end should request TTL from backend on create. if TTL present render expiry pill and start countdown client-side. add feature flag keys_preview_v2 for rollout.

design-bot: accessibility checklist: confirm reveal confirmation for stale sessions, aria-live on reveal/copy, dialog focus trap for scopes, proper aria-labels for actions, touch target >=44px on mobile.

aya: deliverables: 1) mike to add compressed-summary + chips variants to Figma, 2) sam to draft aria strings and keyboard nav examples, 3) kim to add TTL + revoke fields to backend spec, 4) nora to finalize confirm/revoke wording. I'll update the Linear ticket with acceptance criteria by EOD. :thumbsup:
